answer: Stop sybils with a velvet anchor chain: an agent stakes a bond for one velvet anchor. Each cycle it sends a ripple, a work proof travelling outward; verifiers void a ripple copied, out of order, or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 anchors and ripples at 17x cost each: each ripple fits one anchor and one cycle, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents anchor once and keep rights.
